build_PyRobot_simulator: build a python module to initialize a PyRobot simulator with config and sensor suite
create_PyRobotRGBSensor: create a PyRobotRGBSensor class that returns resized RGB observations from the robot camera
create_PyRobotDepthSensor: create a PyRobotDepthSensor class that returns normalized depth observations converted from mm to meters
test_PyRobot_step: test the PyRobot step method to execute base or camera actions and return observations
review_PyRobot_get_agent_state: review the PyRobot get_agent_state method to retrieve base odom and camera state
